comment: One plain-English sentence per agenda item, generated by `python -m ingest.summarize_agenda` and merged into docs/data.upcoming.json by build_upcoming. Keyed by a content hash of the item (see agenda_summaries.item_key) — NOT by agenda number, which restarts every meeting. Safe to hand-edit: a corrected sentence is never overwritten unless you pass --force.

05e97df85e24a1b9.plain: The council will decide whether to undo the property tax increase it approved on August 6.

44d1379a04829650.plain: Staff will present a proposed policy on using property tax money to fund the sheriff's office.

4915eab662b57bd8.plain: The council will decide whether to approve the property tax increase above the certified rate for the coming year.

4c8dca909988e617.plain: The council will decide whether to accept the city's audited books for last year.

52b74e599f6f25c3.plain: The council will review a corrected version of the Overland development agreement change it approved in March, with new wording on paying back infrastructure costs.

546af282b94199e2.plain: Staff will walk the council through a study of how many employees the city needs.

5a14afdb6a34edd6.plain: The council will decide whether to award MGC Contractors the contract for the next stage of the city's sewer plant expansion.

8ba684d24515a262.plain: The council will receive an update on its list of legislative priorities.

8cd6ed72940ec584.plain: Staff will brief the council on the Pony Express Business Park.

b1e8c4237704ee83.plain: The council will hold a public hearing and decide whether to adopt the city's $363,992,973 budget for the coming year.

bdeb0cf52478d4b7.plain: Staff will brief the council on an archery overlay zone.

c06a5f8aa7c78222.plain: The council will decide whether to adopt the official redevelopment plan for the Mid-Valley project area.

c38b1d841e22759c.plain: The council will decide whether to approve an agreement with the city's redevelopment agency to collect and pass on property taxes from the 53-acre Mid-Valley area.

cc87a391d1eb554a.plain: The council will decide whether to approve an agreement with the redevelopment agency and Terra Smith's Eagle Mountain on how Mid-Valley project money is shared and spent.

dce7b896fa3ff12c.plain: The council will hold a public hearing on adding street-naming standards and other requirements to final subdivision maps.

ddf26cbc4aca739a.plain: The council will consider moving the developer's bond for a section of The Towns at Brylee Farms into the warranty stage.

f0ba02de9be5c0f0.plain: The council will hold a public hearing on changing the rules for street names on early subdivision maps.
